div.head: Wif 5
div.ab: Trymme he eal mid wedde þæt þæt he behate; ⁊ aborgian frynd þæt.
Trymme he eal mid wedde þæt þæt he behate; ⁊ aborgian frynd þæt.
Totum hoc uadio confirmetur; et amici sui plegient.
Jener [Bräutigam] bekräftige alles das, was er verheisst, durch Pfand; und [seine] Blutsfreunde sollen das verbürgen.
Let [the bridegroom] confirm with a pledge all that he promises; and let [his] blood-friends stand surety for it.
He is to strengthen all that he promises with a pledge, and his friends are to stand surety for it.

note.seg: Nach Urkk. geschieht dies Bekräftigen sonst mit Worten oder Handschlag
According to charters this confirmation is otherwise made by words or a handshake
Er stellt Pfand und Bürgschaft für die Versprechung in 3; für die in 1. 2 war es sofort miterwähnt
He gives pledge and surety for the promise in 3; for that in 1. 2 this was mentioned at once along with it
